cases.name: mass_normalized_energy
cases.description: All nodes, mass-normalized modes, displacement/rotation, shell stress/strain tensors, EINT, ENER, and masses.

cases.name: max_normalized_energy
cases.description: All nodes, maximum-component normalization, with complete modal energy output.

cases.name: alternate_shell_formulation
cases.description: Ishell=4 drives the CZKE3 tangent and energy-recovery path; the default Ishell=12 cases drive CBAKE3.

cases.name: selected_nodes_and_eig_clamp
cases.description: Explicit all-part node selection plus translational /EIG clamping on interface group 11.

cases.name: frequency_window
cases.description: Mass-normalized extraction of every mode in the bounded 180-250 Hz window before output.

cases.name: fixed_count_frequency_window
cases.description: The first two modes in a bounded interval are selected through native spectrum slicing.

cases.name: bounded_interval_shortfall
cases.description: A bounded fixed-count request returns every available mode with a warning when the interval contains fewer modes than requested.

cases.name: inclusive_fixed_target_boundary
cases.description: A fixed-count lower boundary coincident with a mode remains inclusive without a singular shift failure.

cases.name: fixed_target_excludes_search_guard_only_mode
cases.description: A mode inside the wider numerical search guard but outside final boundary acceptance must not consume one of the requested fixed-target slots.

cases.name: inclusive_interval_boundaries
cases.description: Both endpoints of an all-modes interval remain inclusive when they coincide with computed modes.

cases.name: exclude_search_guard_only_mode
cases.description: A mode just above the requested physical upper boundary is excluded from output.

cases.name: fixed_target_shortfall
cases.description: A fixed-target request returns every remaining mode with a warning when fewer than Nmod exist above Freqmin.

cases.name: displacement_only
cases.description: Modal displacement without rotation, mass, or element scalar requests.

cases.name: rbe2_dependent_lumped_mass
cases.description: A full six-DOF RBE2 with /ADMAS on its dependent node exercises T^T M T, translation-rotation coupling, and expanded modal kinematics.

cases.name: energy_without_mass_payload
cases.description: EINT and ENER output without requesting the optional ANIM mass arrays.

cases.name: solve_without_animation
cases.description: The eigensolve applies the default tolerance and completes without native animation output when /ANIM/DT is absent.

cases.name: reject_empty_frequency_window
cases.description: Expected failure when Freqmin excludes every eigenvalue.
cases.expected_error: /EIG found no modes in requested range

cases.name: reject_multiple_eig_requests
cases.description: Expected failure for the current single-request public solver boundary.
